subject: SprintWave pilot: priority signal + procurement window?
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@averysolutions.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SprintWave discovery — proposed pilot timeline & next steps

Hi Lisa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Goals you mentioned: reduce inference cost at peak traffic, keep 99th-pct latency under 350ms, and preserve red-teamed prompt quality for customer-facing flows.
- Proposed pilot: 4-week technical pilot (staging → 1 region production), up to 500k tokens/day simulated, Redwood-managed runtime with telemetry access.
- Success metrics: 20% token cost reduction vs current setup, SLOs met in 95% of P95 windows, and no regression on 3 core prompt suites.

Action items I promised:
1) Attach a brief pilot proposal and scope sheet (attached).
2) Share an indicative pricing/discount grid for pilots and a procurement checklist for your procurement team.
3) Suggest dates: start week of Dec 13 (run Dec 14–Jan 8) to validate Q1 runway.

Could you confirm: is the week of Dec 13 still a viable window from your side? Also, do you want us to loop procurement now or after you confirm internal alignment?

I’ve attached the one-pager and scope sheet for review. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call with procurement if that speeds approvals.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pilot-proposal-SprintWave-v1.pdf (pdf), pilot-scope-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@averysolutions.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SprintWave discovery — proposed pilot timeline & next steps

Hi Lisa — looping back on this in case it dropped off your plate. We were hoping to lock the pilot start so engineering can reserve the Dedicated slot and we can get the SOW out to procurement.

If the Dec 13 start is tight, no problem — curious whether the window slides to Jan or if you prefer we park until your budget cycle is decided. Short options:
- Green: confirm and we kick on Dec 13, we’ll send SOW and provisioning checklist.
- Delay to Jan: we hold a provisional slot and share an amended timeline.
- Pause: we wait until you have procurement clarity.

Quick one-line reply is totally fine — helps us prioritize the end-of-quarter capacity.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Lisa Park <lisa@averysolutions.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SprintWave discovery — proposed pilot timeline & next steps

Hi Soojin — apologies for the slow reply; we had a shifted exec review this week. Short update: procurement and finance agreed we should run the pilot, but leadership asked to push the start to the first week of January to align with the new budget window. The key constraint is the December freeze on new vendor commitments.

We’re still keen — can you hold a provisional slot for Jan 4 start? Also, we’ll introduce you to our procurement lead (procurement@averysolutions.com) next week to start the SOW redline process.

Thanks for the nudge — Lisa
Director of Product Ops | Avery Solutions

Thanks Lisa — that timeline works. We’ll provision a provisional slot for Jan 4 start and update the SOW dates. Next steps from our side:

- I’ll share an updated SOW with Jan 4–Jan 29 dates and a short procurement checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- Vivek will schedule a 20-min handoff with your procurement lead to cover provisioning, security docs and billing path. Vivek — can you take the intro once procurement is looped?

Lisa — if you’d like a brief internal note we can send to your finance team summarizing the commercial guardrails (pilot discount, cancellation window, procurement milestones) to make approvals smoother, we’re happy to provide it.

Appreciate the quick clarity — we’ll keep the provisional reservation but won’t finalize any billing commitments until SOW signed.

Best,
Soojin
